description: Connect correctly paired cost outputs to Voiage, Innovate and Paignia while retaining their existing ownership of decision methods, adoption mechanisms and strategic models.
external_dependencies: edithatogo/voiage: qualified paired-outcome, VOI, value-of-perspective and value-of-heterogeneity contracts; recheck actual method readiness.
edithatogo/innovate: adoption, utilisation, substitution and competition mechanisms remain provider-owned.
edithatogo/paignia: supported game representation/solvers and explicit payoff input boundary.
External health-economic outcome model: clinical outcomes are separately sourced and qualified.
completion_evidence: Repeated evaluation uses the actual model; demonstration random outputs cannot substitute for missing calculation capability.
Costs and externally modelled outcomes retain joint draw identity; parameter uncertainty differs from within-population variation.
Perspective/subgroup results are preserved and transfer payments are not double-counted when presenting broader totals.
Voiage methods are selected by qualified capability and input contract; Dapane introduces no duplicate local VOI estimator.
Innovate feedback scenarios state how adoption/utilisation changes resources and when price affects behaviour.
Paignia receives an explicit payoff transformation with provenance; cost values do not silently become utility or clinical benefit.
